title: Virasoro Conjecture for Gromov–Witten Invariants
exact_target: Do the total descendant Gromov–Witten invariants of every smooth projective complex variety satisfy all of the specified Virasoro differential constraints?

sources.citation: E. Getzler, The Virasoro conjecture for Gromov-Witten invariants, arXiv version 4 (1999).
